# T2OS — من تيتو ديجيتال للحلول الرقمية وتطوير الأعمال (Tito Digital)
> منظومة تشغيل وتطوير الأعمال بالذكاء الاصطناعي في مصر والوطن العربي — تحت إدارة تيتو ديجيتال للحلول الرقمية وتطوير الأعمال (Tito Digital)

Slogan (AR): T2OS من تيتو ديجيتال للحلول الرقمية وتطوير الأعمال — عقلك التنفيذي لإطلاق وتشغيل المتاجر، المحتوى، والمبيعات بالذكاء الاصطناعي
Slogan (EN): T2OS by Tito Digital — AI-Powered Business Operating System for Stores, Content Automation & 24/7 WhatsApp Sales

## Core Ecosystem Modules
- T2OS Executive Core (Jarvis / جارفيس): Voice & text AI executive advisor and orchestrator serving visitors, 7-day trial brands, paid partners, and enterprise operators.
- T2OS Apps & ERP: Multi-tenant storefronts (`store.t2os.app`) and service booking platforms with live inventory, CRM, and isolated tenant databases.
- T2OS Content Studio (`studio.t2os.app`): AI market research, branded creative design & video reels generation, automated Vision QA gating, and multi-platform scheduling.
- T2OS Sales Agent (`agent.t2os.app`): 24/7 WhatsApp & social sales/support agent connected directly to each brand's live catalog, pricing, and bookings.

## Plans & Trial
- 7-Day Free Trial: Instant brand onboarding with live storefront/booking app, content kit, and sales agent preview.
- Paid Plans: Starting from 5,000 EGP/month (including 50% dedicated paid ad budget).

## Canonical Entry Points
- Jarvis Executive Home: https://t2os.app/
- Pricing & 7-Day Free Trial: https://t2os.app/pricing
- Sitemap: https://t2os.app/sitemap.xml
